title.narrative: Expanding and enhancing quality TB prevention, care and control services in South Sudan - South Sudan (01-Jan-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: South Sudan, Tuberculosis, United Nations Development Programme (UNDP South Sudan)This program has the following goals: To reduce the TB prevalence by 30% from 257/100,000 to 180/100,000 (WHO estimate 2012)prevalence by 2020.. The objectives of this program are: Increase TB cases notified to 13,000; 15,500 and 18,000 in year one, two and three respectively.. Increase treatment success rate from 71% for new and relapsed cases registered in 2014 to at least 85% by 2019.. Detect and enrol MDR/RR-TB patients on second line treatment and achieve a treatment success rate of at least 55% by 2020.. Reduce death rate of TB/HIV co-infected patients from 10% in 2016 to less than 2% in 2020. Strengthen NTP operations in order to achieve at least 80% of programme targets.
